'''2022 MPC Cal Aldred DS BHBM''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Cal Aldred]] at [[2022 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Cal Aldred]]
* '''Event:''' [[2022 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open BHBM Aldred DS 2022 MPC.txt |Download]]
